planning_basis: Planner-owned decomposition derived from the current README and repository evidence; README does not prescribe phases, implementation order, architecture, or task decomposition.
core_rule: Player advises -> AI Character decides -> Simulation validates -> World reacts.

phase_policy.release_rule: Each phase ends with independent verification and a manually usable cumulative public release before the next phase activates.
phase_policy.visual_work_rule: 2D, 3D, WebGL, icon, and interface-design tasks may be created in any phase when current functionality, usability, or an earlier defect requires them; visual work is not forced into a fixed phase merely because it exists in the product direction.
